account.title: Account
account.emailHint: Your email is how you sign in and cannot be changed here.
account.rolesHint: A role is changed on the Organization page by someone who holds set_member_role, never here. This is where you see what you hold.
account.invalid: That display name was refused. A name is 1 to 120 characters.
account.denied: You do not have permission to change this profile.
account.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

preferences.denied: You do not have permission to read or change these preferences.
preferences.failed: That could not be done. Try again.
preferences.localeHint: Dates, numbers, and currencies format to this. Machine-readable fields in records, receipts, and exports are never translated.
preferences.timezoneHint: Every date and time in Oxagen is shown in this zone. New accounts start on Pacific time.
preferences.invalid: One of those values was refused. A locale is a BCP 47 tag and a time zone is an IANA name.

security.authenticatorOn: TOTP. Recovery codes let you in when the app is not to hand.
security.authenticatorOff: Not set up. A code from an authenticator app is asked for at every sign-in once it is.
security.codesRefused: That password was not accepted. Try again.
security.codesUncertain: The last request did not come back, so your recovery codes may already have changed. Issue a new set before you leave this page.
security.codesIssued: New recovery codes. The old set is void. Keep these somewhere only you can reach; they are not shown again.
security.codesHeld: Your new codes are still here. The Account dialog held them because they are shown only once.
security.sessionsFailed: Your signed-in devices could not be read. Try again.
security.revokeFailed: This sign-in could not be ended. Try again.
security.revoked: Sign-in ended. The device stops at its next request.
security.sessionsHint: Ending a sign-in stops that device at its next request. It does not touch an agent credential or a run token. Those are revoked on the Agents page, and that is what makes a halt stick.
security.codesBlockedByOther: New codes cannot be issued yet. An earlier sign-in on this page left recovery codes that were never saved, and issuing now would destroy them. Reload the page to continue.
security.codesBlockedElsewhere: Another tab is issuing recovery codes, or holds a set not yet saved. Finish there first. Issuing here would make that set stop working.

privacy.exportHint: A machine-readable bundle of your data, or of the whole organization for an owner or admin. Runs as export_data, a governed action. It queues at once and the download appears here when it is ready.
privacy.queued: Export queued as {id}. This page updates when it is ready.
privacy.expired: That export could not be prepared. Ask for it again.
privacy.denied: You do not have permission to export this data.
privacy.deniedOrg: An organization export needs an owner or admin.
privacy.failed: That export could not be queued. Try again.
privacy.erasureHint: Erasure of your data runs as erase_data on the API, with explicit confirmation. It ends every sign-in at once and schedules the hard delete. It is not a button here.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.parked: {count, plural, one {# write is waiting on a person} other {# writes are waiting on a person}}. Approve or deny them on Fleet.
assistant.needsWorkspace: The assistant answers over one workspace. Open a workspace to ask it something.

intro.title: Ask about this workspace
intro.body: The assistant reads this workspace’s runs, agents, spend and knowledge graph. Every turn is recorded as a run of its own.

composer.label: Ask the assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask about a run, an agent, or what this is costing…
composer.draftTooLong: This request would exceed the message limit. Your existing draft is unchanged. Send or shorten it, then open the recommendation again.

refused.denied: You do not have permission to ask the assistant in this workspace.
refused.invalid: That question was refused. A question is 1 to 32,768 characters.
refused.exhausted: This organization has no budget left for the assistant.
refused.parked: That turn is waiting on an approval before it can answer.
refused.unavailable: The assistant could not be reached. Try again.

avatar.title: Your avatar
avatar.iconHint: Lucide glyphs, the set the product ships. One line weight, drawn in the tone's ink.
avatar.photoHint: An https link to a hosted image: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG.
avatar.toneHint: Solid, soft, or line. Three tones from the house scale, each fixing its own glyph colour, so there is no combination that fails.
avatar.note: Saved with update_profile, like any change to your account.
avatar.noPhoto: Paste an https link to a photo first, or switch to an icon or initials.
avatar.invalid: That avatar was refused. A photo link must be an https address under 512 characters.
avatar.denied: You do not have permission to change this profile.
avatar.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.gone: That approval is no longer listed.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting on a human.
approvals.emptyDetail: A call parks here when policy returns approve. Denials never park; they end the call and are free.
approvals.rowNotBacked: A parked call's risk is recorded, but list_approvals does not return it yet, and no amount, side effect, taint or task is recorded, so the rows name the tool, the agent and the workspace.
approvals.truncated: Oxagen read the first {count} workspaces of this organization. Calls parked in the rest are not counted here.
approvals.note: A resolution mints a single-use approval token bound to the call digest, the agent, the run, and an expiry. It cannot be replayed on a second call. On expiry the call ends and the reason reaches the model.
approvals.interjectionNotBacked: An open interjection is not recorded yet, so this list holds approvals only.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.footer: list_notifications · {count} unread · every kind here maps to a frame kind or an audit event, never to something invented for a bell.
notifications.markDenied: You do not have permission to mark these notifications.
notifications.markFailed: The notifications could not be marked. Try again.
notifications.noWorkspace: Notifications are read in a workspace, and this organization has none you can open.
notifications.footerUnknown: list_notifications · unread count not recorded · every kind here maps to a frame kind or an audit event, never to something invented for a bell.
notifications.marked: Marked {count} read. Reading a notification is itself recorded, so the audit record shows who saw what.
notifications.markedLeft: {count} older unread notifications are not listed here and stay unread.
